product.summary: A drug discovery platform that combines spatial transcriptomics data with AI to support novel target identification, drug delivery and distribution prediction, and mechanism of action analysis. Creates a 'cancer treatment map' that reads both cell location and gene expression in patient tissue.
product.problem_statement: Conventional bulk analysis shows gene expression levels but loses cell location and surrounding microenvironment (tumor microenvironment, TME) context. This often leads good candidates to fail in clinical trials.
product.solution: Builds a spatial transcriptomics database (PortraiATLAS) that preserves cell location information from patient tissue samples, and layers multimodal AI (VGL Suite) and virtual tissue pharmacology (Microscopic-PK/PD) on top to quantitatively predict and validate target-drug-tissue relationships.
key_features: PortraiATLAS: Proprietary spatial transcriptomics DB of 3,000+ tissue samples, 100M+ spatial-resolution cells, 20+ cancer and normal tissue types.
PortraiTARGET: Discovery and evaluation of novel targets for ADC, RPT, bispecific antibodies, TCE, and protein degraders.
PortraiMIX: Analyzes drug and cell locations in tissue without fluorescent labeling or gene tagging.
PortraiMOA: Mechanism of action analysis based on gene expression and cell state changes before and after drug treatment.
VGL Suite: Vision-gene-language multimodal AI that generates virtual spatial omics (Virtual ST) from H&E stained images and clinical metadata.
Portrai Insilicolab: SaaS web platform providing large-scale spatial omics visualization (Explorer) and AI-assisted analysis (PortrAIgent).
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: A self-reinforcing flywheel structure where data, prediction, and validation engines cycle. Has in-house automation capabilities from sequencing raw materials to tissue image data generation and AI analysis. Encompasses hardware and software via MOU with XCENA and CXL-based large-scale bio data infrastructure, and the adoption of Infortrend storage.
product.target_customer: Global pharmaceutical companies and biotechs (Celltrion, Amgen, etc.). Developers of next-generation anticancer drugs such as ADCs, radiopharmaceuticals (RPT), and bispecific antibodies, and research institutions with demand for target discovery, biomarkers, and companion diagnostics.
product.business_model: Three axes: 1) Joint research and milestone contracts with global pharmaceutical companies (Celltrion up to $87.75M / approx. KRW 125.9B); 2) Revenue from platform analysis services and SaaS (Insilicolab); 3) In-house pipeline development (HCC, adenocarcinoma, solid tumors, antibodies, peptides) for biotech upside.

product.summary: OTAC Trusted Access Gateway (TAG) is an OT authentication gateway deployed in front of industrial control system (ICS) endpoints such as PLC, SCADA, HMI, RTU, and DCS. It verifies user identity with a one-time unidirectional dynamic authentication code (OTAC) just before the user controls the actual equipment and blocks unauthorized access.
product.problem_statement: In OT environments, continuous equipment operation and safety are top priorities, making it difficult to frequently apply security patches or change accounts. Default passwords, shared accounts, and long-term remote access permissions are often left unattended, making endpoints like PLCs/HMIs direct attack targets. A breach can lead to production stoppages, equipment damage, and safety accidents. Existing IT security solutions are difficult to apply due to OT environments' unidirectional communication, network segmentation, and air-gapped structures.
product.solution: OTAC TAG is deployed in an inline structure in front of endpoints without requiring equipment replacement, firmware changes, or OEM support. Users generate a changing OTAC from a smartphone app or smart card and enter it; the gateway allows access only after verification. It fundamentally eliminates the risk of fixed password theft and works in closed networks.
key_features: Unidirectional dynamic authentication (OTAC): generates a one-time authentication code per session, cannot be reused or stolen
Optimized for network segmentation and air-gap environments: no continuous network connection required
Applies without modifying existing equipment: no need to replace or reconfigure PLC/HMI/RTU/DCS/SCADA
1:1 inline deployment and gateway redundancy support
Compliant with IEC 62443 FR1 (Identification and Authentication Control), NIS2, CRA, NERC CIP
Obtained US UL certification, KC/CE certifications, international CC certification, and NET (New Excellent Technology) certification
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: The world's first implementation of Unidirectional Dynamic Authentication technology. It was previously considered impossible to simultaneously perform dynamic code generation and user identification without a network connection, but SSenStone solved this with its own algorithm. Protected by over 40 patents (domestic and international).
product.target_customer: Security managers and operational technology teams at companies operating OT environments, including national infrastructure (water resources, energy), global manufacturers (battery, automotive), smart factories, petrochemical, and power sectors.
product.business_model: Sales of OTAC TAG hardware gateways (MGW-OT1000D/MGW-OT2000D) plus licenses and maintenance contracts. When expanding into an OT security hub in the future, it can transition to subscription-based software and cloud service models.

product.summary: Causilo is a Tabular Foundation Model (TFM) that takes structured data organized in rows and columns (sales records, transaction histories, customer information) and performs predictions necessary for business decision-making through a single inference.
product.problem_statement: Most of the structured data owned by companies is in the form of spreadsheets or database tables. Previously, companies had to develop and maintain separate AI models for each task—such as demand forecasting, anomaly detection, and credit scoring—over several months. While LLMs have revolutionized text and images, the core of business operations—'tables of numbers'—remained a blind spot for foundation models.
product.solution: Causilo is a single foundation model pretrained specifically for structured data. Without fine-tuning, it performs predictions on new datasets immediately, given only context (labeled examples). Companies can cover demand forecasting, customer churn prediction, anomaly detection, credit scoring, etc., with one model, without having to operate multiple task-specific models.
key_features: Zero-shot prediction: Instant inference with only context examples, no separate training or tuning.
Ranked 1st in overall, classification, and regression categories on the TabArena global benchmark (single model, September 2026).
Inference speed of 1.4 seconds per fold, fastest among foundation models.
Code and pretrained weights released (non-commercial license); commercial use requires a separate license.
Multiple deployment options: API, cloud (AWS SageMaker), on-premises container, open weights, etc.
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Based on the Data-Axis Transformer architecture. Effectively learns the structural characteristics of tabular data through a row/column cross-attention mechanism. Utilizes hundreds of millions of synthetic datasets for pretraining. Performs prediction in a single inference (in-context learning), eliminating the need for task-specific fine-tuning.
product.target_customer: Companies in manufacturing, finance, retail, healthcare, insurance, and defense that need predictions based on structured data. Also offers on-premises solutions for companies that have difficulty exporting data. Currently collaborating with InBody among domestic companies.
